tasks.memory_basis: Six16CPU immediate-refill queue. Only genuine accepted final geometry may release each macro. Full-GDS escape forecast S96GiB/R128GiB is conservative, not a measured peak; output STA64GiB each, all-port piRC S128GiB/R64GiB. Actual287 control reused only with pinned receipt, byte-identical control prefix/SPEF/parser and same OpenROAD binary. Only changed V after323 accepted geometry; no old281/285/288 qualification. Admission1.2 margin plus16GiB guard and liveRSS may reduce six-way concurrency when sums exceed actual RAM. No repeat of passed M/T/P&R/gates. Staged only; no allocation before at least one geometry receipt is PASSED.
